decisions.reason: Grounds the two coordinate systems in both host files: draft/Occurrence offsets are clipboard-text projection with chips expanded to clipboardText, while insertReference/consumeToken spans use detectText where a chip is one U+FFFC; also accounts for the separator space and identical plain text.

Locates snapshot.draft.length as the span source in add, shows empty-composer coordinates coincide (first paste ok) and that after one chip span {29,29} overshoots the 2-char detect doc so insertReference returns false, producing the toast; explicitly rejects a real concurrent-edit interpretation.

Traces remove passing occurrence.offset/length unconverted, the ignored false return, and the unconditional records.delete that makes the render ternary yield 'unavailable' while the composer chip survives; explicitly ties both symptoms to the same clipboard-vs-detect misread rather than an upload failure.

Derives detectPos = p - sum(length-1) with sanity checks, applies it at both call sites (end-of-draft insert over all preceding occurrences; removal mapped to a one-detect-char span), keeps the draftRev guard, and gates record deletion on a true verb result.

T2 asserts two successive pastes with both chips present; T6 removes a chip with another chip preceding while the other survives; T5 asserts composer chip, occurrence, dock chip and record removed together; T7 covers declined-consumption bookkeeping and T8 the empty-again variant.
